profile.name: Banupriya M
profile.shortBio: Full Stack Developer building responsive, scalable web applications using React, Node.js and Python.
profile.voiceIntroScript: Hi, I'm Banupriya — a Full Stack Software Engineer. I specialize in building scalable web applications and robust REST APIs using React, Node.js, and Python. With hands-on experience across three engineering internships and production projects, I focus on clean architecture, responsive design, and performant systems. I am currently open to full-time engineering opportunities. Feel free to explore my projects or reach out directly to connect. Thank you!

about.leadParagraph: Aspiring Full Stack Developer pursuing B.Tech in Information Technology (CGPA 8.1) at University College of Engineering, Tiruchirappalli. Passionate about architecting responsive user interfaces, reliable server-side APIs, and intelligent AI-assisted tools.
about.secondaryParagraph: Proven track record through 3 software engineering internships across Aescion EDTECH Solutions, Fantasy Solution, and 8Queens Software Technologies, turning technical challenges into practical software deliverables.

projects.title: AI-Powered Fake Certificate Detection using GAN
projects.desc: Full-stack authentication and verification platform with Flask and Bcrypt. Employs GANs to simulate authentic forgery signatures to train a MobileNetV2 CNN classifier achieving 90%+ detection accuracy.

projects.title: Solar PV Health Monitoring & Fault Classification
projects.desc: Real-time monitoring and anomaly diagnostic system built with FastAPI and React. Analyzed 1.37M+ telemetry data records using Random Forest, Decision Tree and SVM models to diagnose operating faults.

projects.title: Bug Tracking & Release Management System
projects.desc: Enterprise workflow suite providing role-based dashboards for Admins, Developers, and QA Testers. Features issue tracking, attachment handling, audit logs, and release readiness checklists.

pts: Architect and implement full stack features across frontend user interfaces and backend API routes.
Collaborate with senior developers on real-world requirements, modular refactoring, and automated testing.
Optimize response latency and database operations for core educational modules.
Developed responsive full-stack modules utilizing HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and Node.js with REST API integration.
Participated actively in agile sprints, peer code reviews, and UI component standardization.
Ensured seamless cross-browser responsiveness and accessibility standards.
Crafted reusable UI components and client-side logic to accelerate internal release cycles.
Managed repository version control using Git/GitHub, resolving merge conflicts and debugging staging issues.
Conducted end-to-end manual and unit validation before production deployments.
